title: OpenClaw VPS Setup & Configuration
summary: Complete documentation of OpenClaw multi-agent AI gateway installed on VPS 180.93.144.98. Includes 4 agents (main/Tony, TD_CTO, TD_PM, Serena_Nguyen) connected via Telegram (4 bots) and Discord (3 bots). Uses CLIProxyAPI on port 8317 (localhost-only) as model proxy with 11 models (Gemini 3, Claude, GPT-5.x). Memory system uses Mem0+Qdrant. Version v2026.4.11 (updated 2026-04-12), config at /root/.openclaw/openclaw.json. Systemd user-level service enabled for autostart. CLIProxyAPI secured to localhost-only binding.
